title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,651–5,700 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 國定指定古蹟；歷史名勝建築

examples.en: Lukang Longshan Temple is recognized as a national historic monument for its exquisite wooden craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 鹿港龍山寺以其爐火純青的傳統木雕大木作工藝，被依法指定為國家級最高等級國定古蹟。

examples.en: The city government allocated dedicated funding to protect centuries-old stone monuments from traffic vibration.
examples.zh: 市政府編列專款專用預算，以保護數百年歷史的石造古蹟免受車流震動破壞。

examples.en: Visitors gathered in the plaza to admire the grand granite monument commemorating local pioneers.
examples.zh: 參訪遊客聚集在廣場上，瞻仰紀念在地先民拓荒墾殖的宏偉花崗岩歷史古蹟名勝。

words.definition: 有形文化資產科學保存與修復

examples.en: Modern architectural conservation relies on non-destructive sonic testing to assess internal timber decay.
examples.zh: 現代建築文化資產科學保存，仰賴非破壞性超音波檢測評估古木柱內部的腐朽程度。

examples.en: International charters emphasize minimal intervention as a golden rule in architectural conservation.
examples.zh: 國際保存憲章一再強調最低限度干預，作為建築文化資產保存修復的黃金法則。

examples.en: The university established a graduate institute specializing in paper and mural painting conservation.
examples.zh: 這所大學創立了專門針對紙質古籍與壁畫修護的文化資產科學保存研究所。

words.definition: 百年國寶古蹟慎重修繕修復工程

examples.en: The meticulous temple restoration took five years, using traditional lime mortar and natural mineral paints.
examples.zh: 這場耗時整整五年的國寶級廟宇古蹟修繕工程，全程採用傳統糯米灰漿與天然礦物彩繪。

examples.en: Architects examined archival photographs from the 1920s to ensure historical fidelity in the facade restoration.
examples.zh: 建築師團隊反覆研讀一九二零年代的歷史老照片，以確保立面修復工程能忠於原味。

examples.en: Improper past repairs were carefully removed during this comprehensive monument restoration project.
examples.zh: 在這次全面的古蹟修復大工程中，過去不當的水泥修補物被細心剔除清除。

words.definition: 威尼斯憲章文資「真實性」原則

examples.en: Adhering to the Venice Charter preserves the historical authenticity of ancient timber beam structures.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵循國際《威尼斯憲章》修復準則，全力捍衛古建築原貌的歷史真實性。

examples.en: Conservators prioritized original material authenticity over making the temple look brand new.
examples.zh: 文資修復師將保留原始材質的歷史真實性列為第一要務，而非刻意將古廟修得煥然一新。

examples.en: Replacing weathered stones with identical local quarry blocks maintained the structure's architectural authenticity.
examples.zh: 採用相同在地採石場的石材替換風化殘件，維持了建築物整體的構造真實性。

words.definition: 可逆性修復材料工法 (方便未來復原)

examples.en: Conservators choose reversible natural adhesives that can be safely dissolved without harming original paint.
examples.zh: 文物修復師嚴選符合可逆性原則的天然膠黏劑，方便未來科技更進步時能安全拆解復原。

examples.en: Modern conservation principles dictate that all structural reinforcements must remain completely reversible.
examples.zh: 當代文資保護原則明確規範，所有結構補強工法與新增支撐皆須保持完全的可逆性。

examples.en: Using reversible bonding agents allows future restorers to adopt improved technologies without damage.
examples.zh: 採用可逆性接著劑施工，能讓未來世代的修護人員在採用更先進技術時不傷及文物本體。

words.definition: 3D 光達雷射點雲數位建檔建模

examples.en: High-density 3D LiDAR laser scans provide millimeter-accurate digital documentation before dismantling begins.
examples.zh: 在動工解體修復前，高密度 3D 光達雷射掃描能為整座古蹟建立毫米級精準度的數位建檔。

examples.en: Detailed photographic documentation records every crack and paint flake prior to chemical cleaning.
examples.zh: 詳盡的高解析攝影建檔，在執行化學清洗之前完整記錄下每道微小裂隙與彩繪起甲狀況。

examples.en: Thorough archival documentation ensures future generations understand how the monument was preserved.
examples.zh: 完備詳實的文獻檔案記錄，能確保後世子孫清晰理解這座珍貴古蹟歷經哪些修復歷程。

words.definition: 斗栱大木作層層出挑懸挑支架

examples.en: The intricate Dougong bracket system transfers heavy roof weights seamlessly down to supporting cedar pillars.
examples.zh: 巧奪天工的傳統斗栱支架系統，將沉重的屋頂重量層層懸挑分散並傳遞至巨木大柱。

examples.en: Each wooden bracket set fits together snugly without requiring a single metal nail.
examples.zh: 每組傳統木製斗栱構件彼此嚴絲合縫咬合，全程無需使用任何一枚金屬鐵釘。

examples.en: Craftsmen carefully inspected each bracket node for signs of insect boring before reinstalling the roof.
examples.zh: 匠師在重新組裝屋頂前，仔細逐一檢視每個斗栱節點是否存在蛀蟲蛀蝕的孔洞痕跡。

words.definition: 榫卯互鎖卡榫抗震減震結構的

examples.en: Flexible interlocking wooden joints act as natural shock absorbers during severe regional earthquakes.
examples.zh: 傳統大木作榫卯互鎖結構，在強烈地震劇烈搖晃時能發揮如彈簧般天然避震減震效果。

examples.en: Master carpenters rely on interlocking mortise-and-tenon connections that tighten under vertical load.
examples.zh: 大木作匠師仰賴精密的互鎖榫卯接合，在承載垂直重量壓迫時咬合得更加緊實。

examples.en: The pagoda's interlocking frame allows slight structural shifting during tremors without collapsing.
examples.zh: 木塔靈活的互鎖骨架在地震來襲時允許微幅擺動卸力，因而歷經數百年風霜依然屹立不倒。

words.definition: 殿堂雕花大樑與通樑；橫樑

examples.en: Master carpenters carved auspicious bats and peonies across the solid Hinoki cypress main beam.
examples.zh: 大木作傳統匠師在整根台灣特選檜木大樑上，精雕細琢出象徵福氣的祥蝠與富貴牡丹。

examples.en: Tension steel cables were concealed inside the hollowed core of the historic beam to provide extra load capacity.
examples.zh: 隱藏在高空古樑內部的補強鋼索，在不破壞外觀的前提下提供了額外的結構承重力。

examples.en: Rain leaking through damaged roof tiles had caused superficial dry rot along the northern beam.
examples.zh: 屋瓦破裂滲入的雨水，曾導致朝北通樑表面產生了局部的乾腐病變。

words.definition: 廟宇單石透雕八角鏤空龍柱；柱子

examples.en: A single block of granite was sculpted into a swirling dragon pillar featuring floating whiskers and claws.
examples.zh: 石雕大師以一整塊花崗岩，透雕鏤空鑿出一根龍身盤旋騰雲、龍鬚飛揚的靈動龍柱。

examples.en: Massive stone pillars support the elevated portico, resisting seasonal typhoon wind loads.
examples.zh: 巍峨沉穩的巨石石柱穩穩支撐著挑高門廊，從容抵禦年復一年季節性的颱風狂風。

examples.en: The courtyard is framed by a majestic row of carved octagonal stone pillars.
examples.zh: 古廟前庭由一排氣勢恢宏的雕花八角花崗岩立柱優雅圍繞。

words.definition: 員光通隨立體透雕精細木雕雕刻

examples.en: The intricate openwork wood carving beneath the eaves depicts legendary warriors marching into battle.
examples.zh: 懸掛於大殿屋簷下方的立體鏤空透雕木雕，栩栩如生刻畫出三國英雄策馬出征的英姿。

examples.en: Centuries of incense smoke have deposited a dark patina over the temple's floral wood carving.
examples.zh: 數百年繚繞的裊裊香煙，在廟宇精緻的花卉木雕構件表面覆蓋了一層溫潤古樸的包漿。

examples.en: The master woodworker demonstrated the ancient carving technique passed down from his grandfather.
examples.zh: 大木雕刻名家現場示範祖父手把手親自傳承下來的百年精妙雕刻刀法。

words.definition: 傳統廟宇彩繪貼金擂金漆藝工藝的

examples.en: Skilled painters restore faded polychrome ceiling murals using fine sable brushes and natural resin glues.
examples.zh: 國寶彩繪大師手持細緻貂毛筆，使用天然樹脂礦物顏料細心修復斑駁褪色的天花板彩繪。

examples.en: Under UV lighting, hidden layers of original polychrome temple decorations were revealed.
examples.zh: 在紫外線螢光燈照射下，深藏於底層的古老多彩彩繪裝飾層被清晰顯影出來。

examples.en: Traditional artisans specialize in restoring historic polychrome wood sculptures across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 傳統文資修復匠師專精於全台各地珍貴多彩木雕神尊造像的加固與補色修護。

words.definition: 神龕神尊純金金箔貼金安金工藝

examples.en: Applying ultra-thin 24-karat gold leaf during deity throne gilding creates an awe-inspiring heavenly radiance.
examples.zh: 在神明寶座雕刻上薄塗漆膠並細心貼上純金金箔，這道安金貼金工藝綻放出莊嚴璀璨的神聖光芒。

examples.en: Traditional gold leaf gilding requires a calm room with zero drafts to prevent tearing delicate sheets.
examples.zh: 施作傳統純金貼金安金工藝時，必須在完全無風的密閉空間進行，以防薄如蟬翼的金箔碎裂。

examples.en: The gilding on the altar was gently dusted using soft feather plumes to avoid scratching the surface.
examples.zh: 匠師手持柔軟的孔雀羽毛拂帚，輕柔拂拭神桌貼金表面的灰塵以防刮花金膜。

words.definition: 天然硃砂與石青礦物研磨顏料

examples.en: Traditional restorers grind raw cinnabar, malachite, and azurite rocks to produce vibrant, fade-resistant mineral pigments.
examples.zh: 傳統彩繪匠人手工研磨硃砂、孔雀石與石青等天然原石，提煉出百年永不褪色的天然礦物顏料。

examples.en: Natural earth pigments react differently to humidity than modern synthetic polymer paints.
examples.zh: 取自大自然的天然礦物礦石顏料，對海島濕度的耐受性與現代人工化學塗料截然不同。

examples.en: Chemical analysis of the temple's blue pigment identified imported lapis lazuli from ancient trade routes.
examples.zh: 透過化學光譜分析大殿彩繪中的群青顏料，鑑定出古代跨海貿易引進的珍貴青金石成分。

words.definition: 天然熟桐油罩光防護清漆；塗漆

examples.en: Brushing a protective coat of boiled tung oil varnish seals painted surfaces against humid sea air.
examples.zh: 在彩繪木板表面均勻塗刷一層天然熟桐油罩光清漆，能形成堅固膜層阻絕海島潮濕鹽霧。

examples.en: Conservators stripped yellowed old varnish to uncover the vivid colors underneath.
examples.zh: 文保修復師細心洗褪發黃變質的陳年保護漆，還原出底層原本鮮豔奪目的原畫色澤。

examples.en: A low-sheen protective varnish shields the outdoor door god paintings from UV sun damage.
examples.zh: 塗布一層低光澤抗紫外線防護清漆，能守護戶外門神彩繪免受烈日曝曬衰褪。

words.definition: 脆弱古蹟彩繪層起甲剝落現象

examples.en: Injecting acrylic emulsions consolidates brittle, flaking pigment flakes back onto dry wooden boards.
examples.zh: 將水性壓克力黏著乳液微量注入起甲空隙，能將脆化起甲剝落的百年顏料層重新牢固回貼。

examples.en: Fluctuations in relative humidity accelerated the flaking of antique lacquer layers.
examples.zh: 環境相對濕度的劇烈起伏波動，大幅加劇了百年漆器表面漆膜的起甲剝落病變。

examples.en: Restorers used heated spatulas with fish glue to re-adhere flaking painted fragments safely.
examples.zh: 修復人員搭配控溫加熱刮刀與天然鰾膠，安全地將起甲翹曲的彩繪殘片平整回貼。

words.definition: 注射加固劑搶救風化酥鬆木質；加固

examples.en: Chemical consolidants penetrate porous rotted wood fibers to consolidate and strengthen fragile beams.
examples.zh: 注入高分子修復加固劑能深入風化酥鬆的木材毛孔，有效固化加固搖搖欲墜的古老木樑。

examples.en: The stone carving specialist used ethyl silicate solutions to consolidate crumbling limestone reliefs.
examples.zh: 石雕修復專家使用矽酸乙酯滲透溶液，深入加固風化粉化的石灰岩浮雕結構。

examples.en: Structural engineers consolidated weakened masonry foundations before erecting temporary steel roof trusses.
examples.zh: 結構技師在架設臨時鋼架屋頂之前，先對日久鬆動的磚石地基進行了全面的注漿加固。

words.definition: 五彩碎瓷碗片剪貼剪黏材料；碎片

examples.en: Artisans clip colorful porcelain bowl shards into feather shapes to assemble glowing mythical phoenixes.
examples.zh: 剪黏大師手持特製鉗子將彩色瓷碗剪裁碎瓷片，巧妙拼貼成屋頂上羽翼斑斕的展翅神鳳。

examples.en: Piles of glazed ceramic shards lie on the craftsman’s workbench, sorted meticulously by shade and curve.
examples.zh: 匠師工作桌上擺滿了各色琉璃碎瓷片，依照弧度曲度與色澤深淺被井然有序地分門別類。

examples.en: Sharp porcelain shards were arranged edge to edge to mimic shimmering fish scales.
examples.zh: 師傅將鋒利的彩色瓷片錯落排列緊密咬合，惟妙惟肖地拼嵌出魚身閃爍波光的鱗片。

words.definition: 鐵絲與灰泥捏塑之剪黏內部骨架

examples.en: Craftsmen bend galvanized wire around lead pipes to form a rigid structural armature for dragon sculptures.
examples.zh: 師傅以鍍鋅鐵絲與鉛管精心纏繞彎折，為屋脊剪黏祥龍搭建起穩固耐風的內部結構骨架。

examples.en: When restoring rooftop figures, corroded iron armatures must be substituted with stainless steel rods.
examples.zh: 修復屋脊剪黏塑像時，嚴重鏽蝕的早期鐵線骨架必須汰換為耐候的不鏽鋼筋骨架。

examples.en: The clay and lime mixture adheres firmly to the twisted wire armature inside the figurine.
examples.zh: 傳統灰泥與糯米漿黏著劑牢牢包覆在扭轉的鐵絲骨架上，賦予立體泥塑紮實的支撐。

words.definition: 糯米灰漿與麻絨調和之傳統灰泥

examples.en: Mixing slaked lime, boiled sticky rice broth, and brown sugar creates flexible, weather-resistant traditional mortar.
examples.zh: 將熟石灰、熬煮濃稠的糯米漿與黑糖水依古法混合，調配出堅韌抗震、經久不裂的糯米灰泥。

examples.en: Never use rigid modern Portland cement to repair historical bricks, as breathable lime mortar is required.
examples.zh: 萬萬不可使用堅硬的現代波特蘭水泥修補老磚，因為透氣微孔的天然石灰砂漿才是正道。

examples.en: Fibrous hemp shreds were blended into the wet mortar to prevent hairline shrinkage cracks during curing.
examples.zh: 在濕潤灰泥中摻入細碎麻絨纖維充分搥打，能有效杜絕灰漿乾燥硬化時產生的細微裂紋。

words.definition: 廟頂西施脊雙龍搶珠剪黏；屋脊

examples.en: The curved temple roof ridge showcases elaborate Jiannian cut-and-paste glass figures battling ocean waves.
examples.zh: 廟宇屋頂優美起翹的主屋脊上，展示著雙龍搶珠與八仙過海等繁複華麗的剪黏泥塑。

examples.en: High typhoon gales dislodged several ornamental porcelain figures along the primary roof ridge.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風夾帶的陣風吹落了主脊上幾尊裝飾性的陶瓷剪黏人物，亟待匠師登高修補。

examples.en: Restoring the colorful roof ridge required scaffoldings towering four stories above the main courtyard.
examples.zh: 修復這座色彩絢爛的廟頂西施脊，需要在天井中搭建高達四層樓的高空施工鷹架。

words.definition: 閩南傳統優雅起翹燕尾脊；燕尾

examples.en: Upward-curving swallowtail roof ridges symbolize imperial prestige and distinguished academic scholarship.
examples.zh: 閩南古厝與宮廟屋頂兩端高高起翹、宛如燕子展翅剪尾的燕尾脊，彰顯出尊貴與文風鼎盛。

examples.en: Traditional village mansions feature graceful swallowtail curves silhouetted against twilight skies.
examples.zh: 傳統聚落官紳大厝那優美起翹的燕尾屋脊剪影，在黃昏天際線下顯得格外典雅端莊。

examples.en: Only officials passing imperial examinations were historically granted permission to erect swallowtail roofs.
examples.zh: 在清代科舉體制下，唯有考取舉人或進士功名的官紳宅第，才獲准建造起翹燕尾脊。

words.definition: 台灣交趾陶五彩軟釉燒陶藝術的

examples.en: Taiwanese Koji ceramic art combines three-dimensional clay sculpting with vibrant, glossy low-temperature glazes.
examples.zh: 台灣傳統國寶交趾陶藝術，將生動細膩的立體泥塑與晶瑩剔透的五彩低溫軟釉完美結合。

examples.en: These exquisite ceramic wall murals have withstood seaside salt spray for over a century.
examples.zh: 這些嵌於外牆的交趾陶壁畫歷經海島鹽霧吹拂超過百年，至今依然流光溢彩。

examples.en: Ceramic relief panels illustrating mythological tales adorn the exterior walls of the shrine.
examples.zh: 一幅幅刻畫上古神仙傳奇的交趾陶立體浮雕飾板，將神龕外牆裝點得莊嚴富麗。

words.definition: 琥珀黃與翡翠綠低溫交趾陶釉彩

examples.en: The lead-silicate mineral glaze melts at 850°C, producing rich, jewel-like emerald and amber lusters.
examples.zh: 在八百五十度窯火中熔融的交趾陶釉彩，在陶偶表面流淌出如琥珀與翡翠般溫潤的寶石光澤。

examples.en: Artisans carefully brush translucent colored glaze onto the raw clay before loading the second kiln fire.
examples.zh: 陶藝匠師在進窯二次燒成前，手執毛筆細心在素燒坯體上薄施半透明的多彩礦物釉藥。

examples.en: Fine craze lines in the glassy surface glaze give antique ceramic figurines their distinctive character.
examples.zh: 玻璃質釉藥表面天然形成的細緻開片冰裂紋，為傳世骨董陶俑增添了溫潤古雅的歷史韻味。

words.definition: 傳統低溫柴燒木炭交趾陶專用窯爐

examples.en: Experienced ceramicists control drafts inside the brick kiln to prevent delicate facial figures from cracking.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的陶藝師精準掌控磚砌陶藝窯爐內的進風微氣流，防止人物陶偶精緻五官在燒製時開裂。

examples.en: Heat within the wood-fired kiln must rise very slowly to allow moisture to evaporate evenly from wet clay.
examples.zh: 柴燒低溫窯爐內的升溫節奏必須極為緩慢，好讓坯體內部的水氣均勻蒸散不致爆裂。

examples.en: When the kiln was unsealed after cooling, every colorful deity figurine emerged in perfect condition.
examples.zh: 經過數日冷卻開窯驗收時，所有五彩神像陶偶出窯皆完好無損、釉色飽滿瑩亮。

words.definition: 水滸傳與三國傳奇交趾陶人物塑像

examples.en: Expressive Koji pottery figurines perched on wall friezes tell dramatic tales of ancient loyalty and righteousness.
examples.zh: 鑲嵌於廟宇水車堵壁面上的交趾陶人物塑像，生動演繹著桃園結義等忠孝節義歷史傳奇。

examples.en: Collectors marvel at how tiny ceramic figurines capture subtle human emotions through delicate smiles.
examples.zh: 骨董收藏家無不讚嘆這些掌中陶偶竟能透過眉眼微笑，傳神捕捉人世間的微妙喜怒哀樂。

examples.en: Vandals once damaged two antique warrior figurines, prompting tighter security installations.
examples.zh: 過去曾有不良人士破壞屋簷上的兩尊武將陶偶，促使管委會全面升級紅外線防盜監控。

words.definition: 傳統清水紅磚砌築工藝；石工

examples.en: Skilled masons restored the collapsed red brick masonry walls using authentic Dutch bond laying patterns.
examples.zh: 砌磚老師傅遵循古法英式砌法與荷蘭砌法，將倒塌的清水紅磚磚造牆體細心修復如初。

examples.en: Historic brick masonry relies on lime-based joints to allow moisture trapped in walls to breathe.
examples.zh: 傳統古磚砌體工法仰賴天然石灰填縫，使深層牆體內部受潮的水氣得以自由呼吸蒸散。

examples.en: Earthquakes test the shear strength of unreinforced brick masonry, requiring internal carbon-fiber bracing.
examples.zh: 劇烈地震考驗無筋紅磚砌體的抗剪剪力，修復時常需在隱蔽處導入碳纖維網進行微創補強。

words.definition: 閩南傳統紅磚 (薄磚尺二磚)；磚塊

examples.en: Kiln-fired Minnan red bricks pave the temple courtyards, absorbing heavy summer rain puddles naturally.
examples.zh: 窯燒閩南清水紅磚鋪滿古廟前庭天井，吸水透氣且在大雨過後能迅速排乾積水。

examples.en: Traditional red bricks vary slightly in color and texture, giving the courtyard paving unique warmth.
examples.zh: 傳統手工柴燒紅磚色澤深淺溫潤、質地各具紋理，賦予老中庭鋪面無與倫比的人文溫度。

examples.en: Conservators sourced vintage recycled bricks from dismantled old houses to rebuild the damaged garden wall.
examples.zh: 修復團隊特地從拆除的閩南老宅中收購老舊回收磚，用以修補遭地震震損的花園照壁。

words.definition: 琉璃筒瓦與板瓦屋頂瓦作；鋪瓦

examples.en: Layers of overlapping barrel and pan tiles protect the roof timber boarding from monsoon leaks.
examples.zh: 陰陽相間、層層錯疊鋪設的琉璃筒瓦與板瓦，如堅固鎧甲般保護屋頂木板免受季風豪雨滲漏。

examples.en: Workers painstakingly stripped broken clay tiles and replaced them with hand-molded replacements.
examples.zh: 屋頂瓦匠逐一挑除破碎龜裂的舊陶瓦，並以純手工脫模的仿古板瓦予以替換修復。

examples.en: Proper tile spacing ensures water runs off roof slopes quickly without pooling.
examples.zh: 嚴謹精準的瓦壟排距與起伏弧度，確保暴雨能順著屋頂傾角飛速排瀉而不積水。

words.definition: 瓦當滴水雕花屋簷排水構件；屋簷

examples.en: Rainwater cascades gracefully from carved ceramic eave tiles during afternoon thunderstorms.
examples.zh: 每逢午後狂暴雷陣雨，雨水順著屋簷邊緣精雕細琢的瓦當與滴水化為一道道優美水簾傾瀉而下。

examples.en: Deep overhanging eaves shield decorative woodwork from direct tropical sun and beating rain.
examples.zh: 寬幅深遠出挑的大殿飛簷，為下方繁複精緻的木雕構件擋住了南台灣的烈日狂曬與斜風驟雨。

examples.en: Swallows return each spring to build mud nests beneath the sheltered timber eave beams.
examples.zh: 每年初春，燕子總會飛回屋簷木樑避風處，以濕泥草莖築巢繁衍下一代。

words.definition: 濕氣引發之木結構真菌腐朽；腐爛

examples.en: Improving roof ventilation arrests fungal wood decay, extending the lifespan of ancient rafters.
examples.zh: 改善屋架頂部的通風對流，能從根本阻絕真菌滋生引發的木材腐朽，大幅延長古木樑壽命。

examples.en: Entomologists discovered moisture trapped behind false ceilings was fueling internal timber decay.
examples.zh: 昆蟲與病理專家發現藏在木作夾層暗處的濕氣滯留，是導致內部古樑菌絲腐朽的罪魁禍首。

examples.en: Left unchecked, wood decay fungi can hollow out load-bearing columns within a single decade.
examples.zh: 若不及時處置，木材腐朽菌會在短短十年間將整根主要承重木柱的核心徹底蛀空。

words.definition: 防範地下白蟻蛀蝕國寶木構建築

examples.en: Non-toxic underground baiting stations eliminate subterranean termite colonies threatening historic pillars.
examples.zh: 在古蹟四周土壤埋設無毒餌劑監測站，能從源頭消滅威脅國寶木構古建築立柱的地下白蟻巢穴。

examples.en: Specialized acoustic detection tools listen through timber to detect chewing termites inside beams.
examples.zh: 文資維護人員使用超音波聽診感測器隔柱探測，能即時察知藏於巨木深處白蟻啃食的聲響。

examples.en: Termite damage in historic temples is prevented by keeping structural wood raised dry above damp soil.
examples.zh: 預防木造古蹟白蟻蟲蛀的根本良方，在於確保木柱底座架高乾燥、遠離潮濕土壤。

words.definition: 古蹟展示室恆溫恆濕微氣候環控

examples.en: Installing precision sensors maintains a stable micro-climate inside the historic temple archive room.
examples.zh: 在古蹟典藏室安裝精密感測除濕設備，維持恆溫恆濕的微氣候環境，守護古老經書。

examples.en: Display cases maintain an internal micro-climate with 50% relative humidity to protect silk tapestries.
examples.zh: 展櫃內部維持在相對濕度百分之五十的獨立微氣候，以呵護脆弱珍貴的明清刺繡神幔。

examples.en: Heavy stone walls naturally regulate indoor micro-climates, buffering extreme temperature spikes outside.
examples.zh: 厚實沉穩的石砌厚牆能發揮天然調溫功能，有效緩衝外部酷熱極端的溫差巨變。

words.definition: 傳統大木與彩繪匠師收徒薪傳；學徒

examples.en: The national living treasure took on three dedicated young apprentices to pass down his carpentry secrets.
examples.zh: 被指定為人間國寶的大木作大師正式收下三位年輕熱血的傳習學徒，傾囊相授一身絕技。

examples.en: As a junior apprentice, he spent years sharpening chisels and mixing natural glues before carving.
examples.zh: 身為剛入門的小學徒，他在親自下刀雕花前，整整花了三年磨刀、熬膠與練基本功。

examples.en: Many traditional crafts face extinction unless passionate apprentices step forward to learn.
examples.zh: 許多珍貴的無形文化傳統技藝正面臨失傳危機，亟需有心學徒投入拜師傳承。

words.definition: 聯合國教科文組織無形文化資產的

examples.en: Folk performing arts, religious rituals, and traditional crafts form precious intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 民間陣頭說唱、祭祀儀軌與傳統手藝，共同構築起島嶼最珍貴動人的無形文化資產。

examples.en: Documenting oral histories preserves intangible wisdom that written architectural records often miss.
examples.zh: 透過深度口述歷史採訪記錄，能保留下許多古蹟建築圖面所無法記載的無形營造口訣。

examples.en: The government registered temple dragon boat chanting as an important intangible cultural treasure.
examples.zh: 文化部依法將端午水上龍舟號子陣頭，正式登錄為國家級重要無形文化資產進行保存。

words.definition: 白沙屯媽祖徒步進香遶境；朝聖

examples.en: Over a million devout pilgrims join the annual Baishatun Mazu walking pilgrimage across central Taiwan.
examples.zh: 超過百萬名虔誠信眾齊聚參與一年一度的白沙屯媽祖徒步進香，徒步數百公里為島嶼祈福。

examples.en: Walking hundreds of kilometers on the annual temple pilgrimage offers spiritual renewal and reflection.
examples.zh: 在一年一度跨縣市的徒步進香長征中苦行數百公里，為萬千信眾帶來了心靈的昇華洗滌。

examples.en: Villagers along the pilgrimage route offer free food, water, and foot massages to passing walkers.
examples.zh: 進香隊伍沿線的熱心鄉親主動擺設結緣茶水站、提供熱食與痠痛貼布，溫暖每位隨香客。

words.definition: 遵循古禮之宗祠祭祖三獻祭典儀軌

examples.en: The solemn ancestral temple ritual follows ancient Qing dynasty court ceremonial music and offerings.
examples.zh: 宗祠內莊嚴肅穆的祭祖儀軌典禮，嚴格遵循清代宮廷大成樂章與三獻禮古制，代代不輟。

examples.en: Burning incense and reciting protective scriptures are central steps in the morning temple ritual.
examples.zh: 焚香祝禱與虔誠唱誦祈福經典，是宮廟每日清晨啟門開光儀式不可或缺的核心步驟。

examples.en: Elders explain the symbolic meaning of each ceremonial ritual to younger family participants.
examples.zh: 家族耆老耐心地向年輕後輩解說祭祖儀軌中每一道奉酒行禮背後深遠的象徵倫理意涵。

words.definition: 在地鄉親守護家鄉古蹟文化聚落

examples.en: Local community volunteers organize historic walking tours to share their ancestral neighborhood stories.
examples.zh: 在地社區志工主動發起文化走讀導覽，帶領年輕學子深入老街巷弄探索家族歷史記憶。

examples.en: Active community involvement is essential for keeping restored historic districts vibrant and lived-in.
examples.zh: 在地社區居民的主動參與，是讓活化修復後的歷史街區保持生機盎然與生活氣息的活水。

examples.en: The old port community mobilized swiftly to prevent the demolition of the century-old grain warehouse.
examples.zh: 老港口社區全體鄉親迅速串聯集結，成功搶救了面臨怪手拆除危機的百年老穀倉。

words.definition: 凝聚歷史文化記憶與土地國族認同

examples.en: Preserving historic monuments deepens collective memory and anchors our shared cultural identity.
examples.zh: 悉心守護歷史古蹟能深刻凝聚全體國民的共同歷史記憶，並為這座島嶼的文化認同奠定根基。

examples.en: Traditional street architectures give historical port towns their unique geographical identity.
examples.zh: 鱗次櫛比的老街牌樓傳統店屋，賦予了昔日商港古鎮獨一無二的在地風貌與認同。

examples.en: Losing historic landmarks weakens younger generations’ sense of cultural connection and identity.
examples.zh: 歷史地標建築的無端消逝，將削弱年輕一代對家鄉土地的情感臍帶與深層文化認同。

words.definition: 國寶大師爐火純青之傳統匠人手藝

examples.en: The breathtaking joinery and gold gilding celebrate centuries of refined Taiwanese craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 令人嘆為觀止的斗栱榫卯與金箔擂金彩繪，彰顯出歷經數百年淬鍊的台灣頂尖傳統工藝技術。

examples.en: Admirers travel from afar to witness the breathtaking woodworking craftsmanship displayed on temple beams.
examples.zh: 眾多文史愛好者從全台慕名而來，爭相瞻仰大殿樑棟上令人拍案叫絕的木作匠人神技。

examples.en: True traditional craftsmanship balances patient physical mastery with profound aesthetic restraint.
examples.zh: 真正登峰造極的傳統匠人手藝，乃是在千錘百煉的耐力與深邃收斂的美學修養間取得平衡。

words.definition: 東方宮廟傳統建築工藝美學

examples.en: The sweeping roofs and delicate carvings embody the harmonious philosophical aesthetics of traditional architecture.
examples.zh: 飛揚展翅的屋脊飛簷與精雕細琢的樑柱木雕，完美體現了東方傳統建築天人合一的工藝美學。

examples.en: Traditional courtyard homes reflect an organic spatial aesthetics that balances public hospitality and private intimacy.
examples.zh: 傳統三合院空間格局體現了兼顧熱情待客與內斂私密性的有機哲學美學。

examples.en: Understanding classical East Asian aesthetics helps tourists appreciate why temple roofs swoop toward the sky.
examples.zh: 深入理解東亞古典建築美學，有助於旅人領會為何宮廟燕尾屋脊會如羽化登仙般昂揚翹向天際。

words.definition: 跨越數百年延綿不絕之文化延續性

examples.en: Passing ancestral traditions down to our children guarantees cultural continuity through the centuries.
examples.zh: 將先民智慧、歲時節慶與神明信仰一代代傳承給下一代，確保了島嶼文明數百年來延綿不絕的延續性。

examples.en: The revival of ancient temple festivals creates a vital bridge of historical continuity for modern youth.
examples.zh: 百年迎神祭典的風華再現，為當代年輕人搭建起一座跨越世代的歷史文化延續性橋樑。

examples.en: In times of rapid urbanization, maintaining architectural continuity keeps city memories intact.
examples.zh: 在都會急速擴張的浪潮中，保持歷史建築的脈絡延續性，才能讓城市的集體靈魂記憶完好長存。

words.definition: 寶島珍貴無價之文化歷史遺產

examples.en: Every ancient brick and carved beam is an irreplaceable piece of our shared national heritage.
examples.zh: 每一塊歷經風霜的古磚與每一根雕花木樑，都是全體國民共同擁有、無可取代的珍貴文化遺產。

examples.en: School curricula now incorporate field visits to help pupils appreciate their rich regional heritage.
examples.zh: 國中小鄉土課程如今納入古蹟實地踏查，引導孩子親身觸摸並熱愛家鄉深厚的歷史文化資產。

examples.en: International tourists visit historic old streets to immerse themselves in authentic cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的國際背包客穿梭在老街紅磚拱廊下，深深沉醉於真實純粹的文化歷史遺產之中。

words.definition: 匠人一生專注一事之無私奉獻虔敬

examples.en: The master carver’s lifelong devotion to temple art shines through every stroke of his chisel.
examples.zh: 木雕大師畢生對宮廟藝術的無私奉獻與虔敬熱愛，在他落下的每一刀每一鑿中閃耀發光。

examples.en: Tens of thousands of worshippers demonstrate incredible spiritual devotion during the night procession.
examples.zh: 數萬名隨香信眾在徹夜進行的神轎夜巡遶境中，展現了感人肺腑的純粹信仰虔敬。

examples.en: Decades of unheralded devotion by preservationists rescued the old city gates from demolition.
examples.zh: 數十年間文史工作者默默無聞的奔走奉獻，終於成功將歷史老城門從怪手的無情拆卸下搶救保留。

words.definition: 撫慰萬千信眾心靈之神聖心靈殿堂

examples.en: The tranquil temple inner courtyard serves as a spiritual sanctuary for weary city souls seeking peace.
examples.zh: 祥和寧靜的廟宇大殿深處，是一座撫慰無數疲憊都會心靈、帶來平靜祥和與庇佑的神聖心靈避風港。

examples.en: Escaping the bustling downtown noise, she entered the sanctuary to pray quietly for family health.
examples.zh: 暫時逃離市中心喧囂的人潮車流，她步入大殿深處合十默禱，為全家祈求平安無恙。

examples.en: The ancient temple grounds remain a sanctuary of calm amidst a rapidly modernizing metropolis.
examples.zh: 這座古意盎然的廟宇園區，在急速摩天化現代都會叢林中，宛如一處安撫心神的心靈避風港。

words.definition: 莊嚴神聖不可侵犯之古老聖地

examples.en: Stepping inside the centuries-old main hall fills visitors with a profound sense of sacred tranquility.
examples.zh: 懷著肅穆的心情跨入這座數百年歷史的古老正殿，空氣中瀰漫著一股令人由衷敬畏的莊嚴神聖氣息。

examples.en: Pilgrims removed their hats and whispered out of respect for the sacred altar space.
examples.zh: 踏入大殿的參拜者紛紛自覺脫帽、輕聲細語，對神龕前方莊嚴神聖的祭祀空間表達崇高敬意。

examples.en: Ancient trees growing in the temple courtyard are considered sacred guardians of the community.
examples.zh: 廟庭中蒼勁生長的老榕樹被鄉親尊為神樹，視為日夜守護整個聚落庄頭的神聖衛士。

words.definition: 先人順應自然氣候之傳統營造智慧

examples.en: Traditional builders possessed ingenious wisdom, designing courtyard houses that stay cool without air conditioning.
examples.zh: 古代匠師擁有令人讚嘆的營造智慧，巧妙利用四合院天井導風納涼，無需冷氣即可自然通風降溫。

examples.en: Passing down ecological wisdom embedded in native folklore ensures sustainable living.
examples.zh: 傳承深植於在地民俗與農事曆法中的生態智慧，為當代永續綠色生活提供了寶貴養分。

examples.en: Architects today study the architectural wisdom of vernacular residences to design passive cooling systems.
examples.zh: 當代建築大師紛紛回過頭向台灣傳統民居智慧取經，研發出不耗電的建築自然對流排熱系統。

words.definition: 古蹟空間跨越時空與後人的心靈共鳴

examples.en: Standing in the silent colonnade, one feels an emotional resonance echoing from generations past.
examples.zh: 靜靜佇立在斑駁古老的紅磚迴廊中，心靈深處彷彿能聽見數百年前先民跨越時空傳來的深刻歷史共鳴。

examples.en: The solemn bronze temple bell strikes with a rich resonance that echoes across the misty valley.
examples.zh: 破曉時分大殿渾厚的古銅鐘敲響，悠揚深邃的鐘聲共鳴迴盪在整座薄霧繚繞的山谷之中。

examples.en: Oral folk songs possess deep emotional resonance for elderly villagers recounting their youth.
examples.zh: 悠揚婉轉的鄉土民謠，在老阿公老阿嬤耳中激起了對往昔純樸歲月難以言喻的心靈共鳴。

words.definition: 守護古蹟即是賦予文化永恆不朽生命

examples.en: Conserving tangible historical monuments grants cultural memories a form of physical immortality.
examples.zh: 傾力保存看得見摸得著的有形歷史古蹟，就是為這座島嶼代代相傳的共同文化記憶賦予永恆不朽的生命。

examples.en: Great master carpenters attain artistic immortality through the majestic pagodas and temples they leave behind.
examples.zh: 傑出的大木作國寶巨匠，透過其親手督造的雄偉殿堂與寶塔，在人類歷史長河中贏得了藝術的不朽。

examples.en: Ancient poets sought symbolic immortality by inscribing their verse into immortal granite cliff tablets.
examples.zh: 古代文人雅士將滿腹詩篇勒石刻於絕壁花崗岩石碑之上，企盼文章精神能與天地同在、歷久不朽。

words.definition: 古蹟歷史建築乃是這座島嶼的靈魂

examples.en: Historic monuments are not merely piles of bricks and mortar; they are the living, breathing soul of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 歷史古蹟絕非冰冷的磚石瓦片，它們是這座美麗寶島生生不息、真實跳動著的生命靈魂。

examples.en: Music and traditional theater are said to embody the emotional soul of Taiwanese folklore.
examples.zh: 質樸的北管車鼓與傳統歌仔戲，被公認為最能具體代表台灣常民草根文化的真摯情感靈魂。

examples.en: Stripping an ancient port town of its historical alleyways tears out its true historical soul.
examples.zh: 若將百年歷史古鎮的老巷弄全數剷平拓寬，無異於親手將這座城鎮深厚迷人的歷史靈魂連根拔起。
